scope: Run the approved Levels 1-4 taxonomy-generalisation suite after the minimal description, secondary Level 3 rich-guidance, and statistical gates have been frozen. Validation selection remains seen-only and formal test use remains single-pass.
objective: Evaluate the strict Levels 1-4 taxonomy-generalisation suite without changing the approved thesis question or using target-aspect labels for calibration, with one secondary Level 3 DD-versus-RR rich-taxonomy-guidance comparison.
thesis_question: How do lexical, frozen semantic, supervised contextual, frozen LLM, and QLoRA-adapted candidate-label methods degrade as unseen-taxonomy difficulty increases; how much is recovered by minimal label descriptions and task adaptation; and, secondarily, does richer fixed taxonomy guidance improve dual-unseen performance beyond minimal definitions?
canonical_aspects: Purchase booking experience: Ease of use

description_resource.name_only: canonical hierarchical aspect name plus candidate sentiment label
description_resource.minimal: the same canonical name plus one frozen neutral aspect definition and the candidate sentiment label
description_resource.rich: the canonical name and exact minimal definition plus three to five non-corpus aliases, one inclusion boundary, one contrastive boundary, and the candidate sentiment label
description_resource.fixed_rule: Seen labels use minimal descriptions whenever a model consumes label text during task-specific training; frozen similarity methods use the same representation at scoring time.
description_resource.rich_fixed_rule: Rich guidance is used only by the two held-out aspects in the secondary Level 3 RR condition. RR reuses the exact DD-trained model, seen-only threshold, rows, pair identities, and budget; target data or results cannot revise the rich cards.

split_policy.evaluation_rows: all official validation and test rows
split_policy.target_training_rows: remove every official training row containing any heldout aspect
split_policy.test_use: one evaluation after every configuration and statistical rule is frozen

L1_D.heldout: one aspect per fold; twelve folds in canonical order

L2_D.heldout: one aspect per fold; twelve folds in canonical order

pair_training.unit: review x candidate aspect x candidate sentiment
negative_policy: both non-gold sentiments for the same gold aspect
one absent same-parent aspect with the same sentiment when available
one deterministic random absent aspect with the same sentiment

strict_calibration.validation_candidate_scope: construct and score seen-aspect candidates only; held-out candidates are never rendered or scored on validation
strict_calibration.threshold_scope: one method-and-outer-fold threshold transferred from pooled seen-aspect validation evidence
strict_calibration.hyperparameter_scope: nested independently within each unique outer training scope; never pool validation evidence across outer folds
strict_calibration.test_rule: freeze the complete pipeline before one test evaluation

statistics.nonlinear_rule: recompute each metric inside every replicate
statistics.aspect_evidence: paired aspect deltas, wins/ties/losses, and exact sign-flip when at most twenty registered units
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each registered primary sign-flip family; effect sizes and intervals remain primary
primary_families: QLoRA minus matched Frozen Qwen at description-complete endpoints
minimal description minus name-only within matched models, centred on the Level 3 crossover
within-method degradation across L1-D, L2-D, L3-DD, and L4-D
secondary_families: Level 3 RR rich taxonomy guidance minus DD minimal definitions within each matched method
statistics.seed_scope: Levels 2-4 initially include review/fold uncertainty at seed 13 only; final matched Level 1 QLoRA endpoints add seeds 23 and 42

retired_or_deferred: router tuning unless a named post-mainline compute-aware question remains
Level 5 compound organisation plus taxonomy shift
formal_execution_rule: Official seen-only validation selection may start after both description resources, statistics, code, smoke tests, and execution manifests are frozen. Formal test scoring occurs once after every admitted method and threshold is frozen.

tracked: small synthetic smoke summaries without review text
